notes: Synthetic: authored by hand, 2026-10-28; ai.google.dev and cloud.google.com were blocked, so field names and enums come from the machine-readable references named per case in case.json notes. Values (ids, signatures, token counts, vectors, audio, text) are invented. Model: gemini-embedding-2, the current Gemini API embedding model (multimodal; google-gemini/cookbook quickstarts/Embeddings.ipynb). Cases cover the canonical /v1/embeddings path (embedContent for one input, batchEmbedContents for several) and the native embedContent passthrough.

allowed_unknown_fields.reason: known gap G23: the embedding usage the API reports (usageMetadata.promptTokenCount, what embeddings are priced in) is dropped; the canonical usage is hard-coded 0, so embeddings through /v1/embeddings are never billed
